slots_and_copies.name: global_header
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy. Valid iff RAM-image u16 sum over 32 bytes == 0 AND first 8 RAM bytes == 'ROBT0012' (FUN_0802f56c). On failure at boot, FUN_0802f5c8 recreates a blank header from ROM template (FUN_0802f9f4) and blanks all slot prefixes. No backup copy exists.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Independent save slot (EEPROM blocks 4-23). Valid iff u16 sum over the 160-byte RAM slot image == 0 (FUN_0802f8ec via FUN_0802f9d0). Invalid slots are presented as empty (FUN_0802f898 zeroes the 24-byte menu entry). No mirroring or generation counter.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Independent save slot (EEPROM blocks 24-43). Same per-slot sum==0 rule as slot_0 (FUN_0802f91c loads blocks 24*1+4 with count 0x14; FUN_0802f8ec validates).

slots_and_copies.name: slot_2
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Independent save slot (EEPROM blocks 44-63). Same per-slot sum==0 rule as slot_0 (FUN_0802f91c loads blocks 44 with count 0x14; FUN_0802f8ec validates).

checksums.name: header_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: RAM-order decode required: reverse each 8-byte .sav block to get the RAM header. stored = (-sum(u16_le words[0..14])) & 0xFFFF at RAM offset 0x1E (word 15); equivalently sum of all 16 u16_le words == 0 mod 65536. In .sav coordinates the stored bytes are at offsets 24-25 (0x18-0x19, reversed pair). FUN_0802f9d0 is the additive core; FUN_0802f968/FUN_0802f9f4 store the negation; FUN_0802f56c requires sum==0.

checksums.name: slot_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: Validation proven in code: FUN_0802f8ec(slot) returns (FUN_0802f9d0(staging_buffer, 0xA0) == 0), i.e. sum of 80 u16_le words over the RAM slot image == 0. Stored word inferred at RAM slot offset 0x9E (last word) as -sum(words[0..78]) by symmetry with the header; the slot writer is absent from the decompilation, so the stored offset is hypothesised. In .sav coordinates the inferred stored pair is at slot_base+152. Both samples contain only empty slots (sum 0xFFBC), so no sample validates.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 transfer primitive: programs DMA3 source/dest/control (count|0x80000000 enable) via literal-pool register pointers (DMA3 block 0x040000D4), polls enable bit until transfer completes. Used for all EEPROM serial traffic to 0x0D000000.

Read one 8-byte EEPROM block: builds serial read command (start bits + address, MSB-first), DMAs to/from 0x0D000000 via FUN_080423ec, packs 64 bits into 4 u16 at dest+6..+0 descending (source of per-block byte reversal). Bounds block against device descriptor count at desc+4, address bits at desc+8.
Write one 8-byte EEPROM block: expands address + 4 u16 data into serial bitstream, DMAs to 0x0D000000, polls EEPROM ready line (0x0D000000 bit0) with timer timeout. param_3 is retry/verify flag.
Thin wrapper: FUN_08042530(block, src, 1) with retry enabled.
Verify one block: reads via FUN_0804246c and compares 4 u16 against expected; returns 0 on match, 0x8000 on mismatch.
EEPROM device type/timing select (mode 4 used for this 512-byte device); writes descriptor pointers per mode (4 / 0x40 / other).
Read num_blocks*8 bytes: bus lock (FUN_0802fafc), per-block FUN_0804246c with up to 4 attempts, dest+=8/block+=1, bus unlock (FUN_0802fb30). Returns all-blocks-OK.

Write num_blocks*8 bytes with read-back verify: per block FUN_0804251c (write) + FUN_08042690 (verify), up to 4 attempts. All persistent writes use this path. NOTE: ghidra/callgraph.json lists no callers (edges recovered from decompiled.c func_ references).
Additive checksum core: sums (byte_len>>1) consecutive short values with 16-bit wrap and returns the sum.
Validate header: FUN_0802fa34(0,4,buf); requires sum16==0 over 16 words AND 8-byte magic match. Returns validity.

Create blank header: FUN_08024610 copies 32-byte ROM template (incl. ROBT0012 magic), sums 16 words, stores word[15]=-sum, writes via FUN_0802fa90(0,4). Third arg of the FUN_0802fa90 call (buffer) is dropped by Ghidra decompilation; inferred as the header struct.

Flush header if changed: reads EEPROM header, recomputes checksum (zero word at +0x1E, store -FUN_0802f9d0(hdr,0x20)), compares 8x u32 against RAM struct, writes via FUN_0802fa90(0,4) only if different. Returns write result / no-change flag.
Load slot: zeroes 0xA0 staging buffer (FUN_080245a4), FUN_0802fa34(slot*0x14+4, 0x14, staging). Defines slot geometry: start block 4+20*slot, 20 blocks = 160 bytes.
Validate slot: valid = (FUN_0802f9d0(staging,0xA0)==0); caches boolean at struct+0x6C+4*slot.

Boot/load root (caller via unrecovered jump table, not in callgraph): allocates 0xA0 staging buffer (FUN_0802443c), validates header (FUN_0802f56c), recreates+blanks on failure (FUN_0802f9f4/FUN_0802f63c + 3-block blank writes per slot), applies language (FUN_08039120(struct[8]&0x7F)), builds slot list (FUN_0802f898).

Build slot list for slots 0..2: FUN_0802f91c load + FUN_0802f8ec validate; invalid -> zero 24-byte menu entry at struct+0x24+0x18*slot; valid -> struct+0x7C=staging, struct+0x80=0, func_0x08016604(entry) parse (callee not in corpus).
Language-change root (caller via unrecovered jump table): func_0x08035124(1) UI/sound, FUN_08039120(lang) apply, FUN_0802f618 update header byte, FUN_0802f968 flush header.

fields.name: header_magic
fields.update_mechanism: Static ROM template constant copied by FUN_08024610 in FUN_0802f9f4; never mutated at runtime. RAM form 'ROBT0012' obtained by reversing each 8-byte .sav block.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f56c byte-compares 8 bytes after FUN_0802fa34(0,4,buf); FUN_0802f9f4 copies the 32-byte template. Bytes present at .sav offset 0 in both samples; RAM decode yields readable magic 'ROBT0012'.

fields.name: header_language_and_flags
fields.update_mechanism: RAM header offset 0x08 (.sav offset 0x0F via block reversal). FUN_0802f618: byte = (old & 0x80) | (FUN_08039170() & 0x7F) | 0x80; FUN_0802f5c8 reads byte & 0x7F as language into FUN_08039120. Flushed by FUN_0802f968 with checksum recompute.
fields.evidence: Only differing header byte between samples (0x00->0x80, checksum -0x80). FUN_0802f5c8 uses *(byte*)(struct+8)&0x7F; FUN_0802f618 rewrites struct+8 preserving/forcing bit7. Struct base absolute address not in C dump, hence ram_addr null.

fields.name: header_template_bytes_09_0f
fields.update_mechanism: ROM template constants copied wholesale by FUN_0802f9f4; covered by header checksum but never written individually. RAM +0x0E value 0x1E (30) hypothesised as header-size/checksum-offset constant; RAM +0x0D value 0x01 possibly a format version.
fields.evidence: Constant across both samples; only writer is the template copy FUN_08024610(dst,template,0x20) in FUN_0802f9f4. No individual reader found in decompiled.c (checksum-only coverage).

fields.name: header_reserved_zero
fields.update_mechanism: Reserved zero region of the header template (RAM offsets 0x10-0x17; .sav offsets 0x10-0x17 identical since zero). Checksum-covered only.
fields.evidence: Zero in both samples and in the template path; remaining header bytes RAM 0x18-0x1D (.sav 0x18 pair excluded as checksum) are also zero and included in the 32-byte checksum/struct compare.

fields.name: header_checksum

observed_values.cap-00-future-0.sav: stored RAM u16 0xf8ee (.sav bytes f8 ee at 0x18-0x19)
observed_values.cap-01-retained-3.sav: stored RAM u16 0xf86e (.sav bytes f8 6e at 0x18-0x19)

fields.update_mechanism: RAM offset 0x1E (.sav offsets 0x18-0x19 reversed pair). Recomputed on every flush: zero the word, store -FUN_0802f9d0(header,0x20). Covers RAM header 0x00-0x1D.
fields.evidence: Python verification: decoded RAM header sums to 0x0000 and stored==computed on both samples (0xF8EE/0xF86E). Code: FUN_0802f968 stores -FUN_0802f9d0 at +0x1E; FUN_0802f9f4 stores word[0xF]=-sum; FUN_0802f56c requires total sum 0.

fields.name: slot0_blank_prefix
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed at initialisation: FUN_0802f5c8 zeroes the staging buffer (FUN_0802f63c) and writes 3 blocks via FUN_0802fa90(4,3,buf) when the header is invalid. Gameplay layout inside these bytes is unknown (no valid slot in corpus).
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f5c8 blank-write loop (start blocks 4,24,44 count 3) matches the 24 zero bytes at each slot start in both .sav files; remainder of slot is 0xFF.

fields.name: slot0_erased_tail
fields.update_mechanism: Never written in the observed lifecycle; retains erased EEPROM state 0xFF. Would hold slot payload bytes (RAM slot +0x18..+0x9D) after a real gameplay save. Size excludes the inferred 2-byte checksum at offset 184.
fields.evidence: Both samples show 0xFF from slot+24 to slot end; slot u16 sum 0xFFBC (invalid/empty per FUN_0802f8ec rule).

fields.name: slot0_checksum_inferred
fields.update_mechanism: Inferred stored word at RAM slot offset 0x9E (.sav offsets 184-185 reversed pair): -sum of the other 79 u16 words, mirroring the header scheme. Writer absent from corpus; only the sum==0 validation (FUN_0802f8ec) is proven.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f8ec proves the sum==0 check over 0xA0 via FUN_0802f9d0; stored-word position inferred from header symmetry (last word). Not verified: no valid slot sample exists.

fields.name: slot1_blank_prefix
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed at initialisation via FUN_0802fa90(24,3,zero_buf) in FUN_0802f5c8. Gameplay layout unknown.
fields.evidence: Matches blank-write geometry (blocks 24-26); FUN_0802f91c(1) loads blocks 24..43 (param 1*0x14+4, count 0x14).

fields.name: slot1_erased_tail_and_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Erased tail (RAM slot +0x18..+0x9F) including the inferred checksum word at RAM +0x9E (.sav 344-345). No writer observed.
fields.evidence: All 0xFF in both samples; per-slot validation rule proven (FUN_0802f8ec) but payload layout and checksum stored offset unverified without a populated slot.

fields.name: slot2_blank_prefix
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed at initialisation via FUN_0802fa90(44,3,zero_buf) in FUN_0802f5c8. Gameplay layout unknown.
fields.evidence: Matches blank-write geometry (blocks 44-46); FUN_0802f91c(2) loads blocks 44..63 (param 2*0x14+4, count 0x14).

fields.name: slot2_erased_tail_and_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Erased tail (RAM slot +0x18..+0x9F) including the inferred checksum word at RAM +0x9E (.sav 504-505). No writer observed.
fields.evidence: All 0xFF in both samples; per-slot validation rule proven (FUN_0802f8ec) but payload layout and checksum stored offset unverified without a populated slot.

fields.name: slot_gameplay_payload_all_slots
fields.update_mechanism: Unknown: the gameplay slot writer (serialise state into 0xA0 staging buffer, fix checksum, FUN_0802fa90(slot*0x14+4,0x14,buf)) is absent from the 294 trace-guided functions; only the reader/validator side was traced. Valid slots would additionally be parsed by func_0x08016604 (not in corpus).
fields.evidence: Exhaustive text search of decompiled.c: FUN_0802fa90 is never called with count 0x14; no store of a negated FUN_0802f9d0 result to staging+0x9E exists. Both samples contain zero valid slots.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Still rejected (sum and magic both required by FUN_0802f56c) -> blank-recreate as without repair. Distinguishes magic failure from checksum failure.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Predicted no observable change (template constant, no individual reader). Any behaviour change promotes this byte to a live field.

open_questions: What gameplay fields occupy a populated 160-byte slot? No valid slot exists in this corpus (both samples are blank/erased), so all slot payload fields are UNKNOWN.

Where is the gameplay slot writer? No FUN_0802fa90 call with count 0x14 (20 blocks) and no negated-checksum store to staging+0x9E exists in the 294 trace-guided functions; the slot stored-checksum offset (+0x9E) is therefore HYPOTHESIS.

What is the absolute RAM base address of the save struct? Ghidra literal-pool symbols (_DAT_0802f59c etc.) appear in decompiled.c without their pointed-to values, so ram_addr is null everywhere and only struct-relative offsets (+0x08, +0x20, +0x24+0x18*i, +0x6C, +0x7C) are known.
What does func_0x08016604 (valid-slot parser, not in the corpus) extract from a valid slot, and what is the layout of the 24-byte per-slot menu entries at struct+0x24?
What does bit 7 of header byte +0x08 signify beyond being forced on by FUN_0802f618 (language confirmed vs save initialised)?
Who calls the roots FUN_0802f5c8 (boot) and FUN_08020ca0 (language change)? Both have no callers in callgraph.json and are reached via unrecovered jump tables; trigger state/menu context is inferred.
Are header template bytes RAM +0x09..+0x0F (FF FF 00 00 01 1E 00) pure constants, or does any non-traced code path read them individually (e.g. 0x01 as format version, 0x1E as checksum offset)?

Note on slot_sum16 verified_on_samples: stored_hex 0xffff is the erased word at the inferred stored offset and computed_hex 0x0043 is the negation that would be required (-sum of the other 79 words = 0x0043, since total slot sum is 0xFFBC); match=false correctly reflects that both samples hold invalid/empty slots, not a checksum failure of a valid save.
